request: Vault read-only completion audit via existing common Host terminal. Do not disclose secrets.

bounded_host_request.command:
set -eu
printf 'VAULT_HOST_DIAGNOSTIC\n'
docker ps -a --filter name=libral-vault --format 'name={{.Names}} status={{.Status}} image={{.Image}}'
if docker container inspect libral-vault >/dev/null 2>&1; then docker inspect libral-vault --format 'state={{.State.Status}} health={{if .State.Health}}{{.State.Health.Status}}{{else}}none{{end}} image_id={{.Image}} started={{.State.StartedAt}}'; else echo 'VAULT_CONTAINER_NOT_FOUND'; fi
printf 'VAULT_REPO_DISCOVERY\n'
for d in /home/admin1/projects/Libral-Vault /home/admin1/projects/libral-vault /home/admin1/Libral-Vault; do if [ -d "$d/.git" ]; then printf 'repo=%s head=' "$d"; git -C "$d" rev-parse HEAD; fi; done
printf 'END_VAULT_DIAGNOSTIC\n'
